title: percent_encode_msgid and decode_msgid_from_url have no roundtrip test
description: The encode and decode functions for message-ID URL encoding are in different files (outbound.rs and inbound.rs), tested only independently. There is no roundtrip test that verifies encode(decode(encode(msgid))) == encode(msgid). The asymmetry in which characters are decoded (%20 is missing) was not caught because no cross-file test exists. A contributor adding a new character to the encoder will need to know to update both files. Fix: add a roundtrip test in either file that imports both functions and verifies encode/decode symmetry for a representative set of message-IDs.
